{"text":"A 30% rise in energy prices would reduce next year's profit by €7,000.

* Next year's profit would fall to €55,400, compared to €62,400 without the shock.
* Even with this shock, your cash is expected to last the full 12 months, with a lowest balance of €35,000.
* The impact is partially mitigated because 50% of your energy bill is fixed for the next five months.","calls":[],"mode":"none","model":"@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it"}

runs.answer:
Applied a shock: Energy +30%

A 30% rise in energy prices would reduce next year's profit by €7,000.

Next year's profit would fall to €55,400, compared to €62,400 without the shock.
Even with this shock, your cash is expected to last the full 12 months, with a lowest balance of €35,000.
The impact is partially mitigated because 50% of your energy bill is fixed for the next five months.
